title: Agentic AI & Secure Implementation for Banking IT Teams
subtitle: Converted from the Crucible KTB 2026 v2 session study guides
audience: Banking IT and development teams evaluating agentic AI with security guardrails.
outcomes: Understand what agentic AI is and where humans stay in control
Apply agentic AI to Dev and IT ops use cases inside guardrails
Map agentic workflows to OWASP LLM and API security risks
Run secure code review and supply-chain checks with AI assistance
Plan safe adoption: read-only first, least privilege, human approval, audit trail
